subject: Graceband request: short-term throughput uplift and rebate framing for launch
messages:
From: Alicia Torres <alicia@shopscale.com>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-06-21T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Short-term headroom for June 28 product launch

Hi Rafael,

We’re ramping up for our June 28 feature launch and expect a concentrated burst of inference traffic for ~72 hours around launch. Our internal forecast shows a peak that would exceed our current quota by ~3.2x for a 48-hour window.

Two asks:
- Can Redwood provide a short-term throughput uplift (temporary headroom) for June 27–29 to avoid throttling?
- If we accept a short-term surcharge or staged commit, what discount / rebate structure can you offer for the overrun and for a follow-on committed monthly commit?

Attached is a brief launch plan and expected token/time breakdown. We’re looking for a pragmatic path — preferably a short grace period + a retroactive true-up that avoids the launch being rate-limited.

Thanks,
Alicia Torres
Head of Platform, ShopScale, Inc.
Alicia.Torres@shopscale.com
+1 (415) 555-0184

Attachment: shopscale-launch-plan.pdf (PDF stub, 1 page)

From: Rafael Mendes <rafael@redwood.com>
To: Alicia Torres <alicia@shopscale.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-06-21T11:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Short-term headroom for June 28 product launch

Hi Alicia — thanks for the context and the plan. We can absolutely support a short-term uplift; we have a couple of operational approaches depending on risk tolerance:

Options we can provision quickly:
1) 48-hour graceband: allocate temporary headroom and waive overage charges for the first 48 hours; any sustained usage beyond that window moves to an overrun true-up.
2) Phased commit + rebate: short-term uplift now + convert to a 3-month stepped commit where ShopScale receives a retroactive rebate if monthly usage meets agreed tiers.
3) Immediate uplift with staged billing: temporary uplift (first 72 hours) billed at an elevated rate, then reconciled and partially credited if you sign a 6-week provisional commit.

My recommendation for a launch with unpredictable burst is Option 1 or Option 2. To get this over the finish line I’m looping in Ben (pricing/ops) and Laura (finance) to validate the concession we can offer and any PO / DocuSign needs.

Ben, Laura — can you weigh in on PO requirements and whether we can approve a 48-hour graceband + a convertible commit that includes a tiered rebate? If yes, I’ll set up the short window and send a deal summary for signatures.

Alicia — if you can share a quick peak-token estimate (tokens/sec and total expected over the 48/72h window) that will help us size the uplift and draft the rebate tiers.

Rafael Mendes
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
rafael@redwood.com | (650) 555-0112

----
Original attachment referenced: shopscale-launch-plan.pdf

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-06-22T08:15:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Short-term headroom for June 28 product launch

Rafael — thanks for the loop. Rafael/Alicia, quick operational notes from pricing:

- We can approve a 48-hour graceband that waives overage charges for the first 48 hours, provided we have a signed addendum and PO on file within 5 business days post-launch.
- If ShopScale is willing to convert to a 3-month stepped commit, we can offer a tiered rebate applied to the overrun line-item (examples in attached matrix). The rebate scales with committed baseline increase: 10% rebate at +1.5x commit, 18% at +2x, 25% at +3x (applied retroactively to overrun for the month).
- For immediate sizing: Alicia, please confirm expected peak tokens/sec and total tokens for the 48h. We’ll use that to reserve capacity and estimate potential surcharge exposure.

I’ve attached a quick pricing matrix template that we can fill with exact numbers once you provide the peak.

Ben Carter
Sales Operations | Redwood Inference
Attachment: pricing-matrix.xlsx (XLSX stub)

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Rafael Mendes <rafael@redwood.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-06-23T14:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Short-term headroom for June 28 product launch

Team — Finance can approve a conditional concession under these terms: 

1) Short-term uplift: approve a 48-hour headroom waiver (no overage billing) for the launch window.
2) Commit and rebate: ShopScale signs a 3-month provisional commit within 5 business days after launch. Rebate schedule applied retroactively to the month of overrun per Ben’s matrix.
3) PO + Addendum: require PO and a signed addendum (I’ll attach the terms addendum) that references Deal ID SS-2026-0628. If PO/addendum not received within 5 business days, we will invoice the uplift at standard overrun rates.
4) Region and data controls: confirm region = us and that they will not opt for a private deployment.

I’ve attached the terms addendum draft and included a DocuSign link for signatures. Rafael — please confirm ShopScale is comfortable with the PO timeline and the 3-month provisional commit.

Laura Bennett
Director, Finance | Redwood Inference
Attachment: terms-addendum.pdf (PDF stub)
DocuSign: https://www.docusign.com/en/sign/ABCDEF123456

From: Rafael Mendes <rafael@redwood.com>
To: Alicia Torres <alicia@shopscale.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-06-25T17:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Short-term headroom for June 28 product launch — Confirming path and next steps

Alicia — summarizing the agreed path so we’re all aligned: 

- Provision: Redwood will enable a 48-hour graceband covering June 27 00:00 UTC through June 29 23:59 UTC to prevent rate-limiting during launch. No overage charges for that 48-hour window.
- Post-launch: ShopScale will sign a 3-month provisional commit (Deal ID: SS-2026-0628). If signed within 5 business days post-launch, the rebate schedule in the attached matrix will apply retroactively to the month with the overrun.
- PO & addendum: Laura’s team requires a PO and signed addendum via DocuSign within 5 business days or standard overrun rates will be invoiced.
- Next steps for ShopScale: please provide the peak token/sec estimate and total 48/72h token count so Ben can finalize the pricing matrix and we can reserve capacity. Also confirm region = us.

(Alicia — copying the relevant attachments and links again: shopscale-launch-plan.pdf, pricing-matrix.xlsx, terms-addendum.pdf; HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deal/SS-2026-0628; DocuSign: https://www.docusign.com/en/sign/ABCDEF123456)

If that all looks good I’ll move to provision the graceband and mark the capacity for the tentative launch window.

Thanks everyone — Rafael
